item.title: HyperVibe 0.2.0-beta.8
item.description:
# SiriRemoteForge v0.2.0-beta.8
This release is an upgrade from **v0.2.0-beta.7**. It makes the particle Voice orb clearer and more expressive, supports two connected Siri Remotes without sacrificing input or microphone handoff, fixes native dictation selecting the Mac microphone when remote audio should be available, and lets a new Voice long hold cancel a result that is still processing.
## Upgrade from beta.7
- **Existing beta.7 installation:** use **Check for Updates…** for the authenticated app-only update, or download `HyperVibe-0.2.0-beta.8-macOS-arm64.zip`. - **Important for Siri Remote microphone improvements:** install `HyperVibe-Full-Setup-0.2.0-beta.8-arm64.pkg`. Sparkle intentionally updates only the App; the capture daemon and microphone router changes in this release require Full Setup. - **First installation:** use `HyperVibe-Full-Setup-0.2.0-beta.8-arm64.pkg`. - **Legacy Full Setup:** `HyperVibe-Full-Setup-0.2.0-beta.8-arm64.zip` remains available when the native Installer cannot be used.
These beta artifacts remain non-notarized. The App bundles are ad-hoc signed and the native package is unsigned because the project does not yet have Developer ID distribution certificates. Control-click the download and choose **Open** once; never disable Gatekeeper globally. HyperVibe requires macOS 13 or newer on Apple silicon.
## What changed since beta.7
### More legible, more responsive Voice orb
- The Listening orb now has larger but still refined particles and a borderless frosted material behind the complete sphere. The material stays even inside the orb, feathers only outside its particle envelope, and follows the live envelope instead of exposing a fixed disc or rectangle. - Bright particles and a deliberately neutral dark material preserve contrast over both light and dark application backgrounds without requesting Screen Recording permission. - Soft speech is no longer lost behind a second visual noise gate. Volume, onset and pitch produce stronger motion with longer carry and recoil, while a bounded common breath keeps background noise from pinning the sphere at its maximum size. - Speech deformation is strictly symmetric by latitude layer: a whole layer may expand or contract, but individual points cannot create lopsided bulges. Outward layers simultaneously gain particle size and light, producing the clearer Siri-like sense of visual mass requested after beta.7.
### Seamless two-remote input and microphone switching
- Multiple same-model Siri Remotes are tracked by physical device rather than collapsed into one vendor/product identity. Disconnecting one remote no longer tears down the surviving remote. - Buttons and multitouch surfaces can switch between two connected remotes without a stale release ending the new gesture. A held Siri action remains open until the last physical holder releases. - Native Voice re-arms only the remote that produced the Siri press, including during a handoff. The required generation-3 management interfaces stay open non-exclusively, so either remote can wake its microphone without occupying the IR/radio services.
### Native Voice now wakes and selects remote audio correctly
- Native dictation publishes its own process-owned microphone demand on the raw press edge. The capture supervisor watches that owner for crash cleanup and starts the remote pipeline even though native Voice reads shared memory directly instead of opening the virtual CoreAudio device. - Remote selection waits briefly for fresh frames while losslessly buffering the built-in fallback. A newly launched router starts at the current capture baseline, preventing the previous utterance's tail from leaking into a new turn; an already-live router retains valid pre-roll. - The router accepts dynamically allocated ATT value handles only after the complete direction, notification, length, sequence and Opus framing checks pass. This covers different per-remote GATT layouts without weakening the audio-frame validation.
### Cancel processing by starting a new Voice hold
- If a released Voice turn is still transcribing or rewriting, press and hold Siri again to cancel that old result and immediately begin a fresh Listening turn. - Replacement capture begins on the raw press edge, so the 200 ms long-hold discriminator does not cut off the first phoneme. A quick accidental press discards only the speculative capture and lets the existing result continue. - Every irreversible insertion path checks session ownership. Even if a cancelled provider request ignores cooperative cancellation and returns late, it cannot insert stale text or overwrite the new turn. The visible particle formation morphs directly back to Listening without blinking.
## Verification
- SiriRemoteCore: **134/134 tests passed**. - Packaged native Voice: **122/122 self-checks passed**. - Microphone router parser and monitor-ring tests, capture daemon, HAL driver contract and offline CoreAudio handoff simulation pass with warnings treated as errors. - The release audit expands the app-only ZIP, Full Setup ZIP and native package; verifies checksums, signatures, payload seals, architecture, macOS deployment target, updater metadata and licenses; and rejects private paths, hardware identifiers, personal config and PacketLogger. - The published Sparkle feed and app-only enclosure are checked independently after upload: feed signature, beta channel, monotonic build, URL, content length, archive signature and embedded App version must all agree before the release is considered complete.
Use the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt` to verify all downloads:
```sh shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt ```
This remains prerelease software. It relies on private macOS frameworks and an undocumented Bluetooth voice path; please include the macOS version, remote model and firmware when reporting a reproducible issue.
